title: ElevenViewsBridge Request v1
description: A single action request handed to the ElevenViews Tools bridge over the local IPC channel. The capability must exist in the capability registry; the bridge re-validates scope, caller and approval before running.

requestId.description: Client-generated idempotency key echoed back on the receipt.

capability.description: Registry capability id the caller wants to run.

scope.description: Must match the registry scope for the capability.

parameters.description: Capability-specific arguments, validated against the capability's parameter list.

caller.description: Who is asking. The signed IPC layer (ELE-3160) verifies these against the connecting process.

id.description: Stable caller id, e.g. bundle id or service name.

teamId.description: Apple Developer Team ID of the caller, when code-signed.

signingIdentifier.description: Code signing identifier the bridge validated.

oneOf.description: Local user approval token, required when the capability sets approvalRequired.
